Anna Prophetissa filia Phanuel Luc.2.37. Iesus Christus,Matth.4.2. Luc.4.2. (Apostoli, Luc.10.7. & 24.42.Ioh.21.13.) Paulus & Barnabas.Actor.14.23. Abstinentia commendatur.Luc.1.15.Rom.13.14. Col.2.16.1. Thess.5.6. 1.Tim.3 2.2.Tim.4.5.Tit.1.8.& 2.v.2.3.5.& 1.Pet.5.8. Vide Ieivnii & sobrietatis exempla. Abstinentia a vino,Leuit.10.8.& 11.34 Num.6.3.Iudic.13.v.4.13.Ier.35.6. Ezech.44.21.Luc.1.15.Vide Vinum.
ABSTINENDVM a cibo & potu etiam licito, propter scandalum alterius,Matth.6.16. Rom.14.21.1.Cor.8.13. Abstinentia praeceptum violare nolentium exempla: Rechabitæ, Ierem.35.6.
[ABSYNTHIVM herba, Prou.5.4. figuratè significat grauiss. calamitates, Ier.9.15.& 25.15. Thren.3.15.19. Iniustitiam Amos 5.7.& 6.12. Steliæ cognomen,Apoc.8.11.]

ABVNDANTIA rerum omnium à Deo,Deut.8.18. Abundantia omnium bonorum Dei pactum seruantibus promittitur, Leuit. 26.v.3.4.Deut.8.v.1.2 4.Abundantia bonorum temporalium vitam homini minimè confert, Luc.12.20. [beneplacitum,Deut.33.23.Bonitas, Psal.145.7. Emolumentum,Prou.14.23.& 21.5.Sordes,Iac.1.21.Iuramentum, Gen.26.Prosperitas,Psal.30.7.& 122.6.7. Pro.1.33.Ierem.22.21.]
ABVSVS Christianæ libertatis coercetur, Rom.14.3. &c.1. Cor.8.9.Nominis diuini,1.Sam 23.21.
ABVSVS donorum Dei est,quando ad ignominiam Dei, vel non ad gloriā eius,referuntur:Matt.25.26. Serue male &c.
Abuti prosperitate:Solomon,1.Regum 4.21. Vide Dei donorum abusus,& Prosperitas.

[ABYSSVS, sumitur primò, pro aquarum terræ initio, nempe prima die creationis,supernatantium mole,Gen.1.2.Psal.104.6.Prou.8.24.27. Secundò,pro aquarum terram circumcingentium voragine, Gen.7.11. & 8.2.Iob.28.14.& 38.16.30.& 41.23.Psal.33.7.& 107.26.& 135.6.& 148.7.Ion.2.6. Tertiò,pro aquis dulcibus, fontibus, & riuis abundè fluentibus, Gen.49.25.Deu.8.7.&33.13.Psal.78.15.Pro.3.20. Quartò,pro aquis maris rubri, Ex.15.5.8.Psal.77.17.& 106.9.Esa.51.10.& 63.13. Quintò,pro rubri maris & Iordanis fluctib. Habac.3.10. Sextò

page.notes: The right margin holds only faint, cut-off fragments of text and show-through from the facing page, which are not transcribed. The page number at the foot ("854/A") belongs to the digitiser's label and is not printed on the page, so it is left out. The final line "Sextò" runs on from the text and may be a catchword or the start of the next entry; it is kept as printed. Some numbers in the first paragraph are faint and may be misread.
